entries.text: A tuning YAML with an unknown key now fails to load with an error that names the key, suggests the nearest valid key and lists the valid keys. Before, a typo such as table_tuning for table_tunings was ignored, so the run applied only constraints while still labelled as an explicit tuning file. The check covers top-level keys, constraint sections, platform_optimizations, table tunings and column entries; every shipped template still loads.
